srmarienkirche.name: St. Mary's Church
srmarienkirche.slogan: A brick giant that once out-climbed every building on Earth.
srmarienkirche.line: Its 151-metre tower made it the tallest building in the world from 1548 to 1647, apart from a short spell when Beauvais held the title.

srkoenigsstuhl.name: Königsstuhl
srkoenigsstuhl.slogan: White chalk, green beech and the Baltic 118 metres below.
srkoenigsstuhl.line: Close your bodily eye so that you may see your picture first with the spiritual eye.

srozeaneum.name: Ozeaneum
srozeaneum.slogan: The Baltic and the North Sea, under one roof on the quay.
srozeaneum.line: Opened in 2008, it won European Museum of the Year in 2010 and welcomed its millionth visitor within about a year.

srdom.name: Greifswald Cathedral
srdom.slogan: The brick tower that Friedrich's hometown steers by.
srdom.line: Caspar David Friedrich was baptised in St. Nikolai on 7 September 1774, and later shaped its Neo-Gothic interior.

srrasenderroland.name: Rasender Roland
srrasenderroland.slogan: Steam, whistles and seaside villas at a leisurely 30 km/h.
srrasenderroland.line: The 750 mm narrow-gauge line between Putbus and Göhren has run since 22 July 1895.
